title: Ideas inventory starts, production and ordinary interaction tranche
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: partial actual starts/production/interaction/story crosswalk review; preserve mechanism and evidence distinctions
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual new review covers original301–390: genetics LD3–LD10; intro LC4–LC12; modular-production MD-L1–MD-L4, MF11–MF13/MF23–MF25/MF35–MF37, MW5–MW9; play-beyond-menu PF2–PF18/PF21–PF23/PF25–PF51/PF55–PF57; and procedural-story BU1–BU5. These are listed subsets, not every missing intervening code. Together B534–B537 cover original1–390 only. Original391–1169 remains for actual reading. All source paths, existing source-local IDs and dated states stay intact; none of these rows dispatches implementation.

F2: Genetics LD tests are proposals with useful invariants, not current passed checks. An observer projection can contain an attributed false belief or diagnosis absent from physical truth, so LD3's no projection field absent from truth shorthand needs the actual knowledge/provenance contract rather than a ban on uncertainty or deception. No negative capacity and frozen child-parent input checks apply to their selected domain. Compounding bonuses are compared with the world's chosen intent, not automatically capped as exploits. A new quirk table must not reroll committed history; it may legitimately affect newly created instances under a declared revision. LD6's duplication cleanup needs exact preserved source/chronology and shared-writer ownership, not a blanket rewrite of USER_VISION. Tolerance carriers and dial-change apply-existing/new-only/rebase choices remain scoped to actual mechanisms. A15-card floor or human sample is old proposal scope, not a new universal rule or mandatory human gate.

F3: Intro LC keeps world/place, circumstances, body/life, belongings/obligations and unusual means as separable supported axes. A background name alone grants no literacy, contacts, body faculty or simulated family; real start stock is different from a text/coin-only variation. Preview is free, Begin commits the admitted receipt and no reload rerolls it. A system display is not a source of faculty, and an ordinary background can coexist with unusual means. Debt, injury, exile and heir/return routes need their actual creditor/body/custody/history consumers. Remembered knowledge does not transfer every skill, item or obligation. The old recommendation to deepen ordinary starts first and the broad human play gate do not override the current Klein developer-route/HP sequence and AD42; low-spoiler ordinary starts remain separately owned.

F4: Modular-production follow-ups distinguish a local handcart from cross-site freight, sheltered drying from exposed historical-weather work and a clay process from a living habitat or another material law. Real routes, resident body/tools, rights, site support and clock histories are concrete triggers, not unfinished promises hidden in every local slice. Use existing residence/equipment/custody owners without inventing a parallel housing or staff ledger. Quota release, route shortage, container kind/size overhead and industrial residue each need their selected owner and local rule; nearest-first/proportional shortage and weakest-link overload are proposals, not universal physics. Derived exchange value and recipe cycles preserve an intentional creation method or profitable synergy under AD22/AD38; a loop report does not justify automatically zeroing value or forcing a balance tax. All old emc-cheat/live home-lane labels require current owner recovery before any dependent work.

F5: Play PF keeps actual properties and concrete method/target/part/environment handoffs. An unidentified adhesive can work, and information can guide a route before surveying every interior or granting social permission. A service supplies a real operation without giving permanent mastery; copied instructions, understanding, belief and execution differ. Detection/location/identity/understanding may be separate or legitimately combined by a superior faculty. Source activation, delivery, sustained support and durable aftermath differ; ending a source does not erase already warmed water or a completed repair. Maintained effects compete only for real occupied capacity, with stronger/practiced/parallel means able to remove interference. Body/tool adaptation does not make hand count universal. Amount and conservation matter where the reader uses them, while real creation is valid. Partial work/failure may retain useful outputs, but not guaranteed XP/refund. Ordinary maintenance, travel, preparation or successful use gets no mandatory chores, wear, suspicion or counter solely for balancing.

F6: Exploration PF preserves one-way approach/return constraints, anchored aids versus carried custody, actual sampling versus free inspection and a stable useful place without rerolled visits. Unknown does not mean impossible, and unimplemented coverage is a developer gap rather than fabricated world law. A specific lock/oath may require its mechanism until actual bypass means change it; categories cannot veto an effective reasonable method. The quoted forgiving recovery direction does not authorize undisclosed permanent traps. Narrow PF21/PF55 slice and PF22 coverage proposals do not require all PF rows or another world. Current desktop targets replace copied1366 requirements; a prototype tests findability, not runtime law. Bounded authoring, failure and changed-context scenarios retain AD36/AD43 proof only for the selected operation.

F7: BU1–BU5 preserve optional trope bundles, real-receipt rivalry/mentorship recognition, private causal inspector and per-world frequency/promise/quiet-share reports. Repeated contests are evidence for a selected recognizer, not automatic relationship truth or required hostility. Genre weights from scene observations need edition/locator/actual-read binding; inferred and measured vectors differ. Debug trope or promise truth does not become player knowledge without a real route. No bulk reader, new source acquisition, headless simulation or new story-system priority follows. The original source labels, scene-count denominator and model effort remain dated proposal inputs, not fresh measurements or current spending authority.
reviews.evidence: Original301–330,331–360,361–390 read completely in bounded dense-table outputs. B534–B536 cover1–300;391–1169 not credited. No supplier source body, personal save, source-book reading or runtime validation.
